items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: He was a piano player playing with Leroy Smith's orchestra.

ctx.x: On Victor. But no, the Man of War was with Leroy Smith's piano player. What's his name? Let me see. If I can think of his name. Oh, I don't remember his name. He was a piano player playing with Leroy Smith's orchestra. Leroy Smith was playing then at the time at Shuffle Inn.
Well, we'll look it up later. I got it probably in a bucket home.
